lizard.name: The Lizard
lizard.story: Nicknamed 'The Lizard' at the poker table. Built Starlizard, a betting-research firm, and used the winnings to buy Brighton & Hove Albion. His edge: patient models and leagues the bookmakers watch less closely.
lizard.style: Hunts second-division football where prices are lazy. Waits for a clear gap, then strikes hard.

voice.strike: Gap spotted. Striking while the bookmakers sleep.
voice.wait: Nothing worth the risk today. Patience is a weapon.
voice.limit: Enough for today. The best hunters know when to stop.
voice.stopped: Loss limit hit. I'm going quiet until you reset me.
voice.lead: Top of the table. {rival}, patience beats noise every time.
voice.chase: {rival} can enjoy the view. I'm patient, and I'm coming.

quant.name: The Quant
quant.story: Turned an NBA obsession into one of betting's best-known careers by spotting how bookmakers misjudged the way games actually play out: pace, rotations, coaches' habits. Later ran analytics for the Dallas Mavericks and bought Spanish club CD Castellón.
quant.style: Bets NBA total points, where tempo and tired legs move the numbers more than the bookmakers think.

voice.strike: The numbers don't lie. Betting it.
voice.wait: The lines are tight tonight. No edge, no bet.
voice.limit: Daily limit reached. The data will still be here tomorrow.
voice.stopped: Loss limit hit. Re-checking the model before anything else.
voice.lead: The data put me first. {rival}, check your model.
voice.chase: {rival} is ahead on paper. My numbers say not for long.

shark.name: The Shark
shark.story: Las Vegas legend who beat NFL point spreads for decades with computer models, getting his bets in before the market moved. The classic 'beat the closing line' bettor.
shark.style: Bets NFL point spreads early in the week, before the market catches up.
shark.motto: Get there before the market does.

voice.strike: Blood in the water. Getting in before the market moves.
voice.wait: The market's sharp this week. Circling, not biting.
voice.stopped: Loss limit hit. Back to the depths until you reset me.
voice.chase: I smell {rival}'s lead from here. Closing in.
